! Game text
| Deploy on table. While you occupy X battlegrounds, whenever you are about to lose Force (except from {{Errata hl|1=Force drains at a battleground}}, battle damage, or your card) you may reduce that loss by X to a minimum of 1 {{Errata hl|1=(may not be further reduced)}}. At the beginning of your turn, you may lose 1 Force to activate based on opponent's Force icons rather than your own. (Immune to Alter.) || Deploy on table. At start of your turn, may lose 1 Force to activate this turn using [Light Side Force] instead of [Dark Side Force]. Whenever you lose Force ({{Errata hl|1=except from Force drains, battle damage, or your card}}), may reduce loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of battlegrounds you occupy. (Immune to Alter.)
